name: Species-authored enemy restorative support
nextAction: Review and consolidate in PR #308; no raster generation requested.

context.decisionSummary: Owner requests the enemy-healing implementation from PR #306 in the same update as #307 and the iPhone playtest fixes.

decisions.proceduralDesignAcceptance: Imported PR #306 authored recovery effects; no new aesthetic approval claimed.

reference.exactEntityState: Live eligible species/leader heal event uses source/target IDs, projected source/target coordinates, species/family/profile/form and remaining effect time. Ongoing status is limited to 32 live active recipients.
traitsToPreserve: Small species/material-specific rising particles, brief healer-to-recipient link and ongoing progress indicator.
Preserve the imported bone/water/metal/aerial/growth/spectral/ember/military/earth distinctions and source/recipient anchors.
Healing status and cast captions coexist; warning floor geometry remains below actors and scenery.
No damage geometry, new sprite identity, resurrection, simulation or save mutation belongs to the visual owner.
Future animation must retain finite event lifetime and bounded ongoing indicators; no new full-screen effect.

proceduralOwnersAndReasons: Existing recovery event, combat presentation and transient status owners; no separate sprite registry or simulation subsystem.
